NewsArticle.Title: Artists Recognized
NewsArticle.Content:
Time: Friday, 6 PM PST 9 PM EST unless someone says otherwise.
Location: Mileth Hall (we've given some thought to crowd control)
Hosts: Omner, Graynemeade, Riyan, and Vendes. Others will be helping too.
Participants: Any Mileth Citizen
Hear ye, Hear ye
The government of Mileth has called for a meeting of all concerned Mileth citizens in Mileth Hall. We will be discussing things concerning our beloved town and the welfare and well-being of our citizens. Those with ideas on beneficial laws, or concerns regarding present laws, are especially welcome. All Mileth citizens are welcome to come and share their ideas, hopes, problems, and solutions with the Demagogues, Burgesses, Guard Captains and Judges of Mileth. This is an excellent chance to learn just how the political system functions.
The meeting will be headed by an active Burgess, and those who wish to make a speech before the assembly should ask the burgess or a demagogue first. All who wish to give a speech will be given the chance. At the discretion of the burgess, time will also be allowed for open discussion on a subject relating to Mileth. In the absence of a burgess, the demagogues will choose one from amongst themselves to head the meeting.
Please, do not come with the intent of causing trouble. This meeting is for the benefit of all; do not ruin it for all. Those who cause strife, and do not heed the warnings of the officials may be banished from Mileth for a time period of 8 Temuairan days.
